author: mandd_
quote: Really? Sub 30fps average, characters that are hard to connect with, mediocre gunplay, vehicles made out of cardboard, bugs all over the place (most easily noticeable with vehicle trunks, the bugs there are almost guaranteed). On foot controlls feel very weird (altho this doesnt drag the experience down much for me, just a dislike I'll get used to over time). Plane controls are on par or better than 5's but that doesn't really save it. I dont mind the chore sim as much but the game didnt land for me anywhere as opposed to the previous entries.
